upgrades.label: Add a dedicated GPU
upgrades.description: An RTX 3060 12GB unlocks 7B-14B models at good speeds. Best bang for your buck in local AI.
upgrades.impact: Moves from CPU-only (0.5B-3B models) to running 7B-14B models at 20-40 tok/s. Night and day difference.

upgrades.label: Add a budget GPU
upgrades.description: Even an RTX 3060 12GB transforms CPU-only setups. You go from small models to running Qwen 2.5 7B comfortably.
upgrades.impact: 3-7 tok/s CPU → 20-40 tok/s GPU. Enables coding assistants and real-time chat.

upgrades.label: Upgrade to a high-end GPU
upgrades.description: RTX 4090 24GB or similar. Run the best open models (Qwen 3.5 27B, Llama 4) at full speed.
upgrades.impact: Enables 27B-70B models at 30-60 tok/s. Matches Claude 3.5 Sonnet quality locally.

upgrades.label: Upgrade Mac to 24GB+ unified memory
upgrades.description: More unified memory means bigger models. 24GB+ lets you run 14B models smoothly with Metal acceleration.
upgrades.impact: 7B models at 20-30 tok/s → 14B-27B models at 15-25 tok/s. Big quality jump.

upgrades.label: Upgrade to 64GB+ unified memory
upgrades.description: Mac Studio M2 Ultra 128GB or MacBook Pro M3 Max 128GB. Run the largest open models locally.
upgrades.impact: Enables 27B-70B models at 20-30 tok/s. Workstation-class AI on your desk.

upgrades.label: Switch to Apple Silicon Mac
upgrades.description: MacBook Air M1/M2 or Mac Mini M2 with 16GB unified memory. Metal GPU acceleration works out of the box.
upgrades.impact: Runs 7B models at 15-25 tok/s with Metal. No GPU configuration needed.
